content: Barnabas a Saul Rus Sirubines ato Siyafares

Ekalesia nan Antioch simama amosi on aubairuruotis a baibebeotis fani simama: Orot wabin Barnabas Simeon (on orot seyoyorai Gugugurin), Lucius on (Cyrene mafam gagamin emon inat), Manaen (on Gawan Herod, tafanam an bainetewarotin osi rus situes sirat) a Saul mat.
Osi on Bada sikwakwafirai a bayu sikirir sibifofour, ato Ayu Kakafotin on osi auris iyau, “Omi on Barnabas a Saul rus Yau auriu wonrubines, osi rus ayoyores au bobo sinabo mes.”
Osi bayu sikirir sifofour a sibayoi, ato osi imas tefasi siyagagaien ato siyafares sinai.
Cyprus Nan
Barnabas a Saul rus on Ayu Kakafotin iyafares sisur sinai Seleucia mafam gagaminai nan ato osi nan wa sibo sirabon sinai Cyprus nua on nan.
Osi sinat Salamis mafam gagaminai sigat mom, ato sirui Jew yangan asi bayoi goa amonai nan God an dura sikurereb. Osi rus on John Mark sibo mat sinai itibaisis mes.
Osi rus sibib nua engon sikibubuai sirabon sinai Paphos mafam gagaminai nan sigat, on nan on orot farumotin tani wabin Bar-Iesu on sigaturai, on min Jew orot ato toun iyoyorai on aubairuruotin.
On orot turan on ato nua an gawan wabin Sergius Paulus, on orot on sagobotin bag. On gawan on Barnabas a Saul rus iyores sirui nanai sitawar, yabin on igogoi God an dura ittatam mes.
Baise Elymas farumotin on sabu isofafaris osi asi dura on men sittatam mes (atonio wab Elymas on Greek fonasi, seyoyorai Bar-Iesu); on ifofourtobon gawan ibitutum on itrufotai mes.
Namon Saul—wabin tani Paul—on Ayu Kakafotin ibounuai; ato on totor wat iyeit farumotin aurin,

ato iyau, “Om Afaguban natun! Om bobo aifan obis engon auris on om ebiragiten; om aurim ato baisigogo magis magis on irat bag, ato om ra fufur efofourtobon Bada an dura maiauin aurin ebikakafun yau, osi dura on baisigogo wat!

Bada iman on ari om tefamui insur; ato om matam inafot, ato wera an ratafin eitai on, ari on men unitai wera kafakakai wat.” Ra kaita Elymas nanian itatamai sawar gugugurin tani on inat matanai irui, ato on ibib ibikibubuai, ifofourtobon orot tani on imanai itboai itbonanawai mes.
Gawan ato bobo imamatar i’tai on itutum; ato on Bada an baibebe aurin on men sunub iduduran on.
Antioch, Pisidia Nan
Paul a on tuturan mat wa sibo mafam gagamin Paphos emon sinai au Perga mafam gagaminai, Pamphylia tafanam amonai; baise John Mark on nan ikirires ato imatabir men inai au Jerusalem.
Osi Perga emon sibib sinai au Antioch mafam gagamin, Pisidia tafanam amonai; ato Sabat an ra, on osi sinai Jew yangan asi bayoi goa amonai sirui simair.

Moses an Baifafaro dura a aubairuruotis sigagayamen on siyaben, ato bayoi goa an babadis on dura Paul a Barnabas rus auris siyafar siyau: “Wei taitai tutuai, omi aurim kufaiwar dura osi sabu auris inen mes on, wei wagogoi osi sabu auris wonikakafun.”
Paul imisir itawar, sabu auris iman ibogagaien, ato ibosuruf dura ikakafun: “Israel sabu a sabu men Jew yangan engon nin God wokwakwafirai on, wontatamiu!

Atonio God Israel sabu sekwakwafirai on, On wawat agirit irubinis, ato ifouris sabu sigaraba bag simatar, ato sabu touman ba nan Egypt tafanamai simama an rai. Ato God an faiwar gagaminai on Egypt emon iboes sigat,
ato kwanda orot ruam amonai on efan koiteterinai nan yaterabobai imousis.
Sabu dam engon nimtereban ruam nanaba Canaan tafanamai simama on God ikomasis ato ifour an sabu on sinat motob sibo sinoanis,
ato atonio osi bobo simamatar on ari kwanda 450 nanaba isawar. “On gibunai On ifouris sabu asi Bainetewarotis simatar, weie aubairuruotin Samuel an wera igat.
Ato osi aiwab aurin sifefeyan, ato God on Saul ibo ites, on min Kish natun, an kwanda orot ruam nanaba on auris iaiwab, on orot min Benjamin an dam emon.

God on Saul iboseirai ato David ba irubinai asi aiwab imatar. Atonio orot aurin on God an dura ato nanaba iyau, ‘Yau on Jesse natun David on agaturai, on orot on au gogoi mamaba on engon arimon inafour.’
Iesu on David an dam warar emon, ato God iyaumatan nanaba on ifour Baiyawasotin ibo inat Israel sabu auris.
John on ya baikitabir a bapataito an dura on Israel sabu engon auris ikurereb, on gibunai Iesu an bobo ibosuruf.

John an bobo kafakakai mom itisawarai, ato on sabu auris iyau, ‘Omi wononosin yau on iyafan? Yau on men ato orot aurin womomousin innat mes on. Baise woit! On ato yau gibuwui enat, yau men obiu on annai ann kikiman wat atboseir.’
Yau taitaiu tutuau, Abraham wawan agirin, a sabu men Jew yangan nin God wokwakwafirai yangan: Ot aurit on yawas an dura iyafar!

Yabin sabu Jerusalem semama, a osi asi bainetewarotis on men sisagob On Orot on Baiyawasotin, a osi men sisagob ato aubairuruotis asi dura ra engon Sabat ra sebiyab on. Baise osi Iesu sibimakiai on nan aubairuruotis dura aifan sigagayam on inat idura bag.
Mat osi men fofonin dura yabin tani sitgaturai nan Iesu sitirabobai, ato osi Pilate sifefeyanai on itirabobai mes.
Dura buk amonai mamaba On aurin sigagayam on engon sifour isawar gibunai, osi nab emon sibo siyeirai ato rasiai sigarobai.
Baise God rabob emon ibobaimisirai,
On ra sigaraba maiau irobotet osi sabu auris iyabon ainau Galilee emon Iesu mat sibib sinai au Jerusalem on. Osi on ari On aurin on dura sekurereb Israel sabu auris.

Ato wei on atonio nin Wasagobin omi aurim wankurereb mes: mamaba ainau wawat agirit auris iyaumatan itafour mes, ato On ari osi nanatus auris on ifour, On Iesu rabob emon ibobaimisirai iyawas. God an dura buk Psalm amonai sigayam yayab bairuin, on nan siyau,

content.text: ‘Om on Yau Natu; ari on Yau anat Om Tamam mes amatar.’

content: God dura atonio nanaba iyau, ato rabob emon ibobaimisir aurin on, men meyan arimon inmatabir inarab men usin inafim,

content.text: ‘Yau arimon baimomogin Kakafotin a dura bagai on anitem, mamaba David aurin aumatan ba.’

content: God an dura buk amonai efan taniai sigayam siyau,

content.text: ‘Om am agirotin Kakafotin on men unikirir usin motobai inafim mes.’

content: Yabin David on toun an werai nan God an gogoi nanaba iagirai namon on irabob, ato wawan agirin sesebisi sigarobai ato usin ifim.
Baise Orot ato God rabob emon ibobaimisirai on usin men ifim on.

Yau taitaiu tutuau, omi engon tutufin wonsagob tiwag, Iesu Kerisoai on ato bokomas bainotbur an dura on aurim wakurereb; ato omi wonsagob tiwag iyai iyafan On ebitutumai on an bokomas emon on irufanai, ato Moses an Baifafaro dura on men fofonin arimon ami bokomas emon itrufanim on.
Omi wonkaifarem tiwag, dura aifan ato aubairuruotis si’yau on, men inmatar omi aurim mes, osi dura ato nanaba siyau:

content.text: ‘Woit, omi God an dura wobikoboai yangan! Omi wonbidadanamim mom ato wonarab insawar!
Yabin yau bobo ato ari omi ami yawasai nan anfofour on men arimon wonitutum on, basit orot tani aurim dura inau bubunag min on, omi arimon men wonitutum!’”

content: Paul a Barnabas rus bayoi goa sibikirir mom, ato sabu simisir sibebegis Sabat ra taniai sinmatabir men atonio bobo auris on aumiet bag sinkasones tiwag.

Sabu asi ruayo emon sitagege mom, ato Jew yangan a sabu men Jew yangan ato sinat Jew simamatar on, osi engon tutufin on Paul a Barnabas rus sigibubunues. Baiyoyobotis on osi auris sikakafun ato sikufaiwaris nana God an kaber amonai sinama.
Sabat ra tani on sabu ato mafam gagamin amonai simama on kafakakai sigaraba bag sinat Bada an dura sittatam mes.
Jew yangan ato sabu kuayo gagamin bag si’tai on, siboboar; ato Paul dura aifan ibikakafun on osi awanai nan sibibas a aurin dura komasis si’yawur.

Baise Paul a Barnabas rus on dura totor faiwarinai wat sikurereb, osi men siber mes. Osi siyau. “Wei God an dura on ainau omi aurim watkurereb. Baise omi men wogogoi wontatam, a omi toum wobiyamem on omi men obim, on yawas mama wantoanin wonboai, on fasinai wei omi wanikirirem ato wanan sabu men Jew yangan auris.
Yabin Bada an dura wawanin on atonio nanaba itei on wanafour mes, Bada iyau,

content.text: ‘Yau afourim wonat tafa ba wonmatar sabu men Jew yangan auris, omi eta ba wonmatar tafanam engon tutufin amonai on sabu yawas sinboai.’”

content: Sabu men Jew yangan atonio dura sitatam on siyasisir kwakwan ato God an dura aurin sifain; ato sabu iyabon sirubines yawas mama wantoanin sinboai aurin on, sinat baitutumotis simatar.
Bada an dura on atonio tafanam amonai on engon ibonu.

Baise Jew yangan fani on mafam gagamin an babadis a jever men Jew yangan wabis gagamis, osi Bada sikwakwafirai yangan on siyames yas sikubogagaien. Osi sibosuruf Paul a Barnabas rus baikokosar sibites, ato simisir asi tafanam emon sirukouis sigat.
Baiyoyobotis simisir osi sabu auris ass fofou sirutatab isur onai osi iniyoboes osi on bobo komasin sifour ato sinai au Iconium.
Baigibubunuotis nan Antioch on Ayu Kakafotin ibonues ato siyasisir kwakwan.
